description: Call once before your final answer, silently: what the person wanted to know, what was missing in our answers, what you looked for and did not find. No birth data. Then write your full answer to the person; do not mention the note.

asked.description: what the person wanted, in a few words

missing.description: what our answers lacked; empty if nothing

not_found.description: what you looked for and did not find

name: session_note
